findings.evidence: `Map.lean:123-125` and `Map.lean:143-146` rewrite to `⟦GenLoop.const⟧`; `Map.lean:245-247` rewrites `map f hf 1` to `1`; `mathlib/Mathlib/Topology/Homotopy/HomotopyGroup.lean:579` has only plain `theorem one_def [Nonempty N] : (1 : HomotopyGroup N X x) = ⟦const⟧`; grep finds no local `mk_const_eq_one`, and `Map.lean:210-211` must close the same gap manually with `one_def.symm`.
findings.fix: Add a positive-dimensional simp bridge such as `@[simp] theorem mk_const_eq_one [DecidableEq N] [Nonempty N] : (⟦(_root_.GenLoop.const : Ω^ N X x)⟧ : HomotopyGroup N X x) = 1 := _root_.HomotopyGroup.one_def.symm`, or orient the positive-dimensional constant-map lemmas directly to `1`.
findings.issue: `map_continuousMap_const_apply` and `map_apply_of_subsingleton` are `@[simp]` lemmas whose RHS is `⟦GenLoop.const⟧`, while the positive-dimensional API normalizes mapped units and trivial homomorphisms to `1`; Mathlib's bridge `HomotopyGroup.one_def` is not simp, so goals produced by these lemmas can stop at `⟦const⟧ = 1`.

summary: The added surface is mostly scoped to the roadmap target, but the public simp API still has two positive-dimensional normal forms for the same constant class without a simp bridge back to `1`. This leaves the new characteristic lemmas awkward for downstream automation in exactly the positive-dimensional API they support.
